findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the trust-anchor fix means check_binding_completeness's forgery gap is closed — resolve_rollout_commit's new check only fires AFTER evaluate_binding_completeness already found a HARD gap; that detection depends on _layer_coverage_regen._merge_base, a sibling function that still includes the branch's own @{u} upstream as a candidate ahead of origin/main/origin/master. If that narrows base..head to exclude the only HARD gap, rollout grace is never even consulted -- a full bypass, not merely an unearned advisory downgrade.
findings.suggestion: harden _merge_base's candidate resolution the same way _branch_base_commit was hardened, or show @{u} cannot resolve in the environments this gate actually runs in

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: an ancestor-of-corroborated-trunk-boundary check gives grace only to content a PR-branch-controlling adversary cannot forge — git_helpers._branch_base_commit never fetches; it reads whatever origin remote-tracking refs already exist locally. A local, pre-push iterate run (this framework's own F0/F11) can write refs/remotes/origin/main directly, fabricating a trunk boundary -- the identical forgery class moved one layer up.
findings.suggestion: document explicitly that this anchor is only meaningful in an environment whose origin refs come from a fetch the contributor does not control (CI/merge-time), not a pre-push local run

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: no false-negative regression beyond what the ADRs already disclose — whether a real CI pull_request checkout leaves >=2 independently-resolving trunk candidate names (required by _branch_base_commit's own resolved==1 fail-closed rule) is unverified empirically in this diff's tests
findings.suggestion: confirm empirically in a real GitHub Actions pull_request job, or document that CI-side grace being unavailable there is expected fail-closed behavior

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the new tests exercise the corroboration logic this caller newly depends on — only the two simplest branches are exercised through this caller; multi-candidate-disagreement/rewound-trunk scenarios are covered only at _branch_base_commit's own definition site
findings.suggestion: not required to fix before commit -- acceptable to rebut as redundant coverage since the primitive is already hardened/tested elsewhere and reused verbatim
